description: Seek-sync preroll gate (ADR-0026): frame-0 control case. Loads the 1 kHz tone fixture at position 0, plays from frame 0 (a keyframe -- the gate should release within ~one editor tick since decoders are already warm), waits 1 second, then asserts (a) playback state is still Playing and (b) the video media frame has advanced at least to frame 10 (proving playback resumed after the immediate gate release). Play-from-frame-0 is the no-regression case: it must not hang waiting for a preroll that is already done. Requires tests/fixtures/audio/tone_1khz.mov.
